full_prompt_en: A wide panoramic landscape image depicts a vast rocky mountain basin beneath towering storm clouds. The viewpoint looks down from a high barren ridge into a long valley that narrows toward a hazy central distance. Jagged brown and charcoal rock formations fill the lower half; winding pale erosion lines and steep folds lead the eye from the foreground toward the valley floor. Dark boulders and ridges press against both lower corners, while distant slopes fade into blue-gray atmospheric mist. Above them, the sky dominates the image. A heavy purple-gray cloud ceiling stretches across the top, with a luminous break near the center revealing pale blue and white light. Enormous cumulus forms rise at left and right, their bright cream edges set against darker indigo interiors. The clouds appear layered and volumetric, with smaller fragments dissolving around the distant horizon. A soft shaft of light falls into the middle distance, brightening a narrow area of the far valley, while the near rocks remain in deep, warm-brown shade. The image has a highly rendered, photographic or digital matte-painting quality: crisp terrain textures and subtle atmospheric blending replace visible brush marks. No figures, buildings, or text appear in the selected landscape. The breadth of land below the enormous weather system creates a sense of scale. The long horizontal view, converging rocky folds, and shifting cloud illumination make the wilderness feel both expansive and dramatic.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅宽幅全景风景图像描绘高耸暴风云下广阔的岩山盆地。视点从高处荒凉山脊俯望狭长山谷，谷地向中央带雾的远方逐渐收窄。参差的棕色与炭灰岩石填满下半部；蜿蜒的浅色侵蚀线和陡峭褶皱把目光从前景带向谷底。深色巨石和山脊压在下方两角，远处山坡退入蓝灰色空气雾中。上方的天空主导图像。沉重紫灰云顶横跨顶边，中央一道发亮的云隙露出浅蓝和白光。左右两侧巨大的积云升起，明亮奶油色边缘衬着更暗的靛蓝内部。云层显得层叠且有体积，更小云片在远处地平线附近融化。柔和光束落入中远方，照亮谷地一块狭窄区域，近处岩石仍处于深而偏暖的褐色阴影中。图像具有高度渲染的摄影或数字场景绘制质感：清楚的地形纹理与微妙空气融合取代可见笔触。所选风景中没有人物、建筑或文字。巨大天气系统下方展开的土地宽度建立尺度感。长长的横向视野、汇聚的岩层与变化的云光，使荒野显得辽阔又戏剧化。
style_prompt_en: Panoramic landscape rendering uses a very wide field of view, strong atmospheric recession, and highly detailed terrain texture. Dark warm-brown lower masses are balanced by an even larger cool gray-violet sky, where bright cloud edges form the main highlights. Rocky folds and pale winding lines converge into a misty distance; crisp nearest surfaces give way to softened blue-gray layers. Light breaks selectively through a dense overhead cover, making isolated far areas glow while the foreground stays shaded. Volumetric clouds carry broad soft gradations and small turbulent edges rather than flat graphic shapes. The composition draws scale from a low distant opening beneath immense weather and from the rhythm of layered ridges across the width.
style_prompt_zh: 全景风景渲染使用极宽视野、强烈空气后退和高度细致的地表纹理。深暖褐色下方体块与更大的冷灰紫天空相平衡，明亮云缘形成主要高光。岩层褶皱与浅色蜿蜒线汇入带雾远方；清楚的近表面逐渐让位给柔化的蓝灰层。光选择性穿过密集顶云，使远处局部发亮，前景保持阴影。有体积的云带宽阔柔和渐层与细小翻涌边缘，而非平坦图形。构图从巨大天气下方的低处远景开口，以及横贯全幅的层叠山脊节奏中获得尺度。
theme_en: A vast rocky mountain basin beneath towering storm clouds
theme_zh: 高耸暴风云下的广阔岩山盆地
name: Panoramic view
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
